title: betula kenaica var. japonica
intro: Betula kenaica var. japonica, commonly known as Japanese birch, is a deciduous shrub or small tree species. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Japanese birch include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it effective in treating colds, fever, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Japanese birch include salicin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
